sources.title: hishab/titulm-gemma-2-2b-v1.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Information This model is a continually pre-trained version of the google/gemma-2-2b architecture, fine-tuned on extensive Bangla datasets. The primary goal of the continual pretraining was to enhance the model's ability to generate high-quality Bangla text.

sources.title: GitHub - hishab-nlp/titulm: TituLM Development Library
sources.snippet: We have trained multiple variants of Gemma family models with different sizes and configurations. Our released models are: Gemma 2 2B TituLM-Gemma-2-2B-v1.1: Model trained with 4.4B Bangla tokens with original gemma 2 tokenizer. TituLM-Gemma-2-2B-v1.0: Model trained with 3B Bangla tokens with original gemma 2 tokenizer.
